title: Chrome-led Modern Web Guidance 1.0 steers coding agents to native APIs
summary: A Chrome-led team has released Modern Web Guidance 1.0, an open-source collection of more than 200 curated web-platform best-practice guides \(about 1.7 MB\) meant to steer coding agents doing frontend work toward native HTML, CSS, and browser APIs rather than legacy div-and-JavaScript patterns. It was built in collaboration with Firefox, MDN, and Edge and ships as an npm-installable agent skill and CLI, including a deterministic legacy-scan for finding outdated patterns that the authors say was trained on 30,000 GitHub repositories. The project reports that its test agents improved from 55% to 92% passing across 200 tasks and roughly 1,700 Playwright- and AST-based assertions, but those are author-run results and have not been independently verified.

references.title: The Future of CSS - Josh W. Comeau
